data.description:
EVALUATION.md defines the fast harness command as `uv run python -m unittest discover tests`, and BUILDPLAN calls it the delegators inner-loop clock. It collects only unittest.TestCase methods.

MEASURED (ast walk over tests/test_*.py, 2026-07-10):

  in-TestCase methods : 183   <- what `unittest discover` runs
  module-level test fns:  37   <- invisible to it; pytest collects them
  total               : 220

Breakdown of the 37 invisible tests:
  test_adapters.py : 14
  test_sources.py  :  7
  test_parsers.py  :  6
  test_registry.py :  6
  test_passive.py  :  4

Confirmed by running both: `unittest discover` reports "Ran 183 tests"; `pytest -q` reports 220.

WHY IT MATTERS. 17% of the suite never runs under the documented gate. The 14 in test_adapters.py are precisely the module-level assertions the TB-18 design flags as needing to be tightened from `isinstance(parser, ClaudeParser)` to `type(parser) is ClaudeParser` once HermesTraceParser subclasses ClaudeParser. A weakened assertion in a test the gate does not execute fails silently twice over.

FIX (pick one, do not do both silently):
  a. Change the documented `test` command to `uv run pytest -q`. Cheapest; pytest is already a dev dependency.
  b. Convert the 37 module-level functions into TestCase methods, keeping unittest as the gate.

Option (a) also fixes the TOOLBENCH_LIVE gate uniformly. Option (b) preserves the "pure stdlib runtime" posture of S20 for the test harness too.

ACCEPTANCE. The documented harness command executes all 220 tests, and a test added as a module-level function cannot silently escape the gate.
data.title: unittest discover, the documented test command, silently skips 37 of 220 tests

data.note: The 14 invisible tests in test_adapters.py are the isinstance assertions TB-18 must tighten when HermesTraceParser subclasses ClaudeParser

data.body: RUN-2 INTAKE (orchestrator): Scheduled FIRST in the wave — this ticket repairs the delegators' inner-loop clock. Obligations: (1) the fix must leave one documented fast-suite command that collects ALL tests (uv run pytest -q is the working baseline; unittest discover silently drops bare-pytest-function modules AND executes module-level code, printing a probe table mid-run); (2) DOCS phase authors SPEC criterion S31 + EVALUATION row + BUILDPLAN row (precedent: TB-18's S29/S30) — the Result Validator audits against that row; (3) update EVALUATION 'Harness commands' + README + BUILDPLAN 'Test split'. SHARED-FILE flag: README/EVALUATION also touched by TB-18 Task 6 — note the overlap in the PR body. Branch off origin/main. Gate: uv run ruff check ., uv run mypy --strict toolbench tests, uv run pytest -q, all green pre-PR.
Implementation started. Working against origin/main @ 28b6187e6fd505ab0e5d016a6cd85000e16abe34 (unchanged from branch-cut). Plan written to .lattice/plans/task_01KX58903DF3BJ85EENHJKWCQW.md.

TB-19 VALIDATION EVIDENCE

ruff check .                    -> All checks passed!
mypy --strict toolbench tests   -> 38 errors (baseline is 38; 0 new)
pytest -q                       -> 214/215 passing, 1 pre-existing failure

Pre-existing failure (flagged in self-review, unrelated to this ticket):
tests/test_hermes.py::LiveArchive::test_live_archive_schema_envelope fails
identically on origin/main before any TB-19 commit and under both unittest
discover and pytest -- this machine's live ~/.hermes archive has
sidecar-less WAL profile DBs that toolbench/hermes.py _connect (mode=ro, no
immutable=1 fallback) cannot open. Tracked as TB-18 Task 0 territory.

Acceptance check: uv run pytest -q now collects 215 tests (was 213 before
this branch's +2 new regression tests; the pre-TB-19 unittest discover
count was 176 on this same tree). tests/test_gate_completeness.py directly
pins the defect: unittest.TestLoader.discover finds 1 test in a synthetic
fixture module carrying one module-level test_* function + one TestCase
method; pytest --collect-only finds both (2).
PR opened: https://github.com/mrojas54/tool-benchmarks/pull/21 (base main, head tb-19-pytest-gate @ 46007bb). Confirmed OPEN, MERGEABLE, head.sha != base.sha.

TB-19 COMPLETE — PR #21 (https://github.com/mrojas54/tool-benchmarks/pull/21), base main, OPEN/MERGEABLE.

Shipped: replaced the documented gate command `uv run python -m unittest
discover tests` with `uv run pytest -q` everywhere it's referenced (README,
EVALUATION, BUILDPLAN, AGENTS, SPEC), added `testpaths = ["tests"]` to
pyproject.toml, added tests/test_gate_completeness.py pinning the collection
defect against a synthetic fixture, and added SPEC/EVALUATION/BUILDPLAN S31.
Chose option (a) from the ticket per the orchestrator's run-2 intake comment.

Test counts: ruff clean; mypy --strict at baseline (38, 0 new); pytest -q
214/215 passing.

Deviations/flags:
1. No toolbench/*.py runtime behavior changed — classified this whole ticket
   as docs + pytest-tooling-config, invoking CLAUDE.md's "docs-only edits are
   exempt" carve-out rather than forcing an artificial RED/GREEN pair where no
   real pre-fix code defect existed to fail first.
2. One pre-existing, unrelated test failure survives the gate:
   tests/test_hermes.py::LiveArchive::test_live_archive_schema_envelope,
   caused by toolbench/hermes.py's `_connect` lacking an `immutable=1`
   fallback for sidecar-less WAL hermes profiles on this machine's live
   ~/.hermes archive — this is exactly "TB-18 Task 0" territory per
   session-memory, pre-existing on origin/main before any TB-19 commit,
   identical under both unittest and pytest, and out of scope here. Reported
   as green-modulo-this-one rather than silently claiming full green or
   fixing it under this ticket.
3. Shared-file overlap flagged in the PR body: TB-18's PR #20 also touches
   README.md and EVALUATION.md (S29/S30); expect a routine union merge at
   both files' tails when merge order is decided.

Stopping at `review` per fast-track scope — orchestrator owns merge.

Phase 2 RV validated (rows pass; row 9 partial traced to branch topology — fork predated hermetic commit 5baeca1, resolved by gate-check before merge). PR #21 (tb-19-pytest-gate) MERGED 2026-07-10T11:21:53Z as 3612dcf: pytest gate replaces unittest discover, recovering the 37 silently-skipped tests.
